subject: Supplemental compute stipend for Open Heritage pilot — request
messages:
From: Dr. Sonia Kapoor <sonia.kapoor@openheritage.org>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: supplemental compute stipend to finish pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the fast onboarding — the Open Heritage pilot team has been running nightly OCR+cleanup jobs on the cultural collections and we hit our trial cap last night. We’ve completed ~72% of the archive conversion but the remaining material is the highest-resolution scans (longer seq lengths and larger batch sizes), so our token burn is much higher than the initial estimate.

Quick ask: would Redwood be able to provision a one-time supplemental stipend to carry the pilot through the final 3–4 weeks? We’re looking for roughly 200k token-equivalent credits to finish processing and run our evals. If approved we can share a short final report and a usage snapshot for your case study.

I’ve attached the latest usage_report.csv and a one-page pilot-scope.pdf showing remaining data and timeline.

High-level timeline:
- Finish high-res OCR and cleanup: 3 weeks
- Evaluation & human review pass: 1 week

If there are any quick forms you need filled or an MSA addendum, please point me at them and I’ll get legal to review. Appreciate any flexibility — this project is grant-funded and the supplemental window is tight.

Best,
Sonia Kapoor
Program Director, Open Heritage Foundation
sonia.kapoor@openheritage.org
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: usage_report.csv, pilot-scope.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sonia Kapoor <sonia.kapoor@openheritage.org>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental compute stipend to finish pilot

Hi Sonia — thanks for the clear breakdown and for sending the usage snapshot. I’ve looped in Laura (accounts) and Vivek (programs) to expedite a response.

Prelim answer: we can provision a provisional 200k-token stipend for Open Heritage while we complete internal approvals. I need to confirm a couple quick items from you so the SOW addendum can be scoped:
- Exact pipeline you’ll run post-topup (batch size / typical seq length) — the CSV helps but a line-item is helpful
- Whether you need the credits as account balance or as a time-limited promo (e.g., expires 90 days after grant)

Laura/Vivek — can I get a provisional thumbs-up on a one-time 200k top-up (pilot promo) for OHF? If approved, I’ll send Sonia the DocuSign for an addendum that covers the extended trial terms and the promotional SKU.

Sonia — attaching a short internal form we use for promo provisioning; if you can fill it and return we’ll move faster.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

(650) 555-0122

Jonas — thanks for the ping and for the form. Reviewed the usage_report and the pilot scope; the ask looks reasonable for the expected remaining work. Finance is OK with a one-time promotional top-up if we attach a short SOW addendum that limits liability and defines the credit expiry.

I’m provisionally approving 200,000 token-equivalent credits for Open Heritage (promo SKU: EDU-PILOT-TOPUP). Please note the approvals checklist for legal/finance:
- SOW addendum (I drafted OHF_SOW_addendum.docx)
- Promo expiry: 90 days from issuance
- No refunds; credits non-transferable

Vivek — can you confirm operational provisioning window? If we green-light now, we should be able to apply credits within 24 hours.

Jonas — once we have Sonia’s filled form and sign-off on the SOW addendum, I’ll trigger the promo. I’ve attached the draft addendum.

Cheers,
